rules: two lines, each at most 18 characters counting punctuation; 3 to 7 words

drafts.text:
Lead upright,
the ranks fall in.
drafts.source: Tuan on 7: 能以眾正 (able to make the many upright); Image: embraces the people

drafts.text:
High and low talk:
that is peace.
drafts.source: Image on 11: heaven and earth interact

drafts.text:
High and low part:
turn down rewards.
drafts.source: Image on 12: heaven and earth do not interact
Image on 15: a mountain within the earth

drafts.text:
Turn back
before you go far.
drafts.source: Line 1 of 24: 不遠復 (returning from not far)

drafts.text:
Guard your mouth:
food and words.
drafts.source: Image on 27: careful with speech, moderate in eating and drinking

drafts.text:
The ends give way.
Brace them now.
drafts.source: Tuan on 28: 棟橈，本末弱也 (the ridgepole sags: the root and the tip are weak); Wang Bi on lines 2 and 4: 拯弱 (rescuing the weak)

drafts.text:
Like fire, cling
to what is right.
drafts.source: Tuan on 30: 柔麗乎中正 (the yielding clings to the central and correct)
Judgment on 43: proclaimed in the king's court; resorting to arms is not supported

drafts.text:
Check a bad start
while it's small.
drafts.source: Line 1 of 44: tied to a metal brake (Wang Bi: stop it at its start)
Image on 51: 恐懼修省 (uses fear and trembling to examine themselves)

drafts.text:
No hidden aim,
firm at the core.
drafts.source: Tuan on 61: 柔在內而剛得中 (the yielding within, the firm holding the centres)
